macro.label: VIX: 19.99
macro.text: The VIX rose from 14.84 last week. The S&P 500 fell 1.95% to 7,659, just below its 50-day average. Higher premiums accompany wider daily price swings.

macro.label: 10-year Treasury yield: 5.10%
macro.text: Chip, software and AI shares remain sensitive to rates. Thursday's jobless claims and Friday's business surveys can change yields before new positions open.

macro.label: Wednesday earnings
macro.text: META, TSLA, IBM, TXN and LRCX report after Wednesday's close. Most setups wait until Thursday so their strikes can be assessed against the post-report prices.

macro.label: Dates beyond this week
macro.text: Contracts carry the Oct 28 Fed decision at 11:00 AM Pacific, Microsoft and expected Alphabet earnings that evening, plus Oct 29 GDP, inflation and Intel earnings. Longer expiries also span Nov 3 elections, Nov 6 jobs, Nov 10 CPI, Nov 13 PPI and, for Nov 20 contracts, Nov 17 retail sales and Nov 18 Nvidia earnings. The source suggests a GTC buyback at 50% of entry credit and sizing for assignment.

days.rule: SLV and JPM open from 7:00 AM Pacific. SLV has no company earnings; JPM already reported. If silver or bank shares fall sharply at the open, let the first hour settle. These positions still carry Thursday's claims and Friday's survey risk.

days.name: Tuesday
days.rule: No new setups scheduled from this slate. Keep the chip, AI and software positions for Thursday. DAL waits until Friday after the week's airline reports.
days.event: Housing starts and permits at 5:30 AM Pacific; pending home sales at 7:00 AM Pacific. NFLX, COF, UAL, ALK, GM, GE, RTX and ISRG report; UAL and ALK can affect DAL.

days.name: Wednesday
days.rule: No new setups scheduled. Wait for the evening chip and AI reports before the Thursday batch. UNH also waits for ELV's morning report; DAL remains on hold through Thursday's AAL report.
days.event: Crude inventories at 7:30 AM Pacific; 20-year Treasury auction at 10:00 AM Pacific. ELV reports in the morning. META, TSLA, IBM, TXN and LRCX report after the close; SAP and LUV also report today.

days.name: Thursday
days.rule: The 6 puts and 6 covered calls open from 7:00 AM Pacific, after Wednesday's earnings and the morning claims release. Puts must wait for this window. Use post-gap prices and allow more time after a sharp fall. For NVDA, the source suggests waiting for 3-5 steady sessions before selling a call. Friday's surveys remain ahead; NTAP and DAL wait until Friday.
